items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of resident parking permit
items.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung können Sie Widerspruch erheben; er muss innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde, bei der Stadt Musterbüll, Markt 1, 25899 Musterbüll, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift eingehen.
items.computation: The letter is dated Mon 14.06.2027 and was sent by ordinary post, so under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting = Fri 18.06.2027 (the letter itself states this rule). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day, 19.06.2027, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on 18.07.2027, a Sunday. Under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 19.07.2027. The Widerspruch must physically arrive at the city by this date, not merely be sent.

items.title: Submit declaration of permanent private use of the employer's vehicle (optional, for re-examination)
items.quote: Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach, prüfen wir Ihren Antrag gern erneut.
items.computation: The letter invites submission of a declaration that the car NF-JM 512 is used permanently for private purposes, so the permit application can be reconsidered. No calendar date or period is given for this step, so no exact due date can be derived; it is not a statutory deadline, only a condition for re-examination.

warnings: No explicit deadline is given for submitting the declaration that the vehicle is used permanently and privately ('Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach'); doing this well before the Widerspruch deadline (19.07.2027) is advisable if the person wants the city to reconsider without having to file a formal Widerspruch.
